answer: Because the timing is logged against the island challenge, the plume audit can replay the dawn history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm thus has to pad 176 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which forfeits the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 2805 identities would post 2858 proofs and burn roughly 40 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
